description: Defines the class BeanListResponse used for representing a response containing a list of SugarBean objects and their count, typically used in API responses.

classes.name: BeanListResponse
classes.description: A class encapsulating a list of SugarBean objects and the total row count, designed for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the beans list and row count from the provided result array.

methods.name: getBeans
methods.description: Returns the list of SugarBean objects.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of rows (beans).
